name: claude-kit
description: Claude Code plugins maintained by clayboby. Every plugin reads its endpoints and credentials from userConfig at install time, so no address or token of a private deployment is ever published here.

plugins.name: vagaa-media
plugins.description: Produce video, images, music, speech and translations through your own media gateway, with an asset library, a vision review gate and a storyboard pipeline for long video.

plugins.name: vagaa-web-evidence
plugins.description: Free-first public-web search and page extraction through your own evidence router: one call per turn, citations only from extracted bodies, no paid provider without asking.

plugins.name: vagaa-dgx
plugins.description: Bundle: installs vagaa-media and vagaa-web-evidence together. Ships no components of its own.
